description: Generate model images by combining a source product image with a model head image, optional masks, scene references, and prompt guidance.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the source product or outfit image. The image must be up to 20 MB and between 385 and 8192 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: modelHeadImageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the target model head image. The image must be up to 5 MB and between 512 and 2048 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: imageSegUrl
fields.description: Optional segmentation mask URL for the source image.

fields.name: sceneImgUrl
fields.description: Optional scene reference image URL. The image must be up to 10 MB and between 768 and 4096 pixels in both width and height.

fields.name: sceneStrength
fields.description: Scene reference strength from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.7.

fields.name: modelPrompt
fields.description: Comma-separated model appearance terms, such as smile, laugh, sitting, lying, fat, plump, slim, sideways, profile, back, or bald.

fields.name: customPrompt
fields.description: Positive generation prompt, up to 600 characters.

fields.name: customNegPrompt
fields.description: Negative prompt to avoid unwanted artifacts.

fields.name: genOriRes
fields.description: Whether to generate the original resolution. Defaults to false.

fields.name: realModel
fields.description: Whether to prefer a realistic model style.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
